packageRules.description: doctrine/orm stays below 3.7 while sylius/sylius declares a conflict with it (2026-10-03). orm 3.7.0 added a SchemaValidator check that Sylius' unused ShipmentUnit mapping fails; Sylius 2.2.10 and 2.3.0 answered with conflict "doctrine/orm >=3.7" (Sylius PR #19251, CONFLICTS.md), to be lifted once that mapping is no longer loaded. Without this rule pinup proposes orm 3.7.x next to Sylius 2.3 and composer cannot resolve the pair. Remove this rule when a Sylius release drops the conflict.
